description: LLM-as-judge pairwise comparison — Compare two AI answers to the same question and pick the better one. Judged twice with the answers in both orders to cancel position bias; returns winner A / B / tie, confidence (high only when both orders agree), per-criterion 1-10 scores averaged over both runs, and reasons. Params: question=, a=, b=, optional reference= (ground-truth answer), optional criteria= (comma list, default correctness,helpfulness,completeness,clarity). Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

a.description: e.g. The seasons are caused by the tilt of Earth's axis (about 23.4 degrees), which changes how directly sunlight hits each hemisphere during the year.

b.description: e.g. Seasons happen because Earth is closer to the Sun in summer and farther away in winter.

question.description: e.g. What causes the seasons on Earth?

name: ai_judge_pairwise
